Package com.here.sdk.navigation

Class TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltPolicyOptions

java.lang.Object
com.here.sdk.navigation.TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltPolicyOptions
Enclosing class:
TrackingCameraBehavior
public static final class TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltPolicyOptions extends Object

Configuration for the speed-based tilt policy. Tilt is linearly interpolated between TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltEntry.minTiltInDegrees and TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltEntry.maxTiltInDegrees as speed increases from 0 to TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltEntry.maxSpeedInMetersPerSecond. Above that speed tilt stays at TrackingCameraBehavior.SpeedBasedTiltEntry.maxTiltInDegrees.
